sourceFile: 12.1 TIU C11-20 Report checking sound check Test VP new mold V3.3 date 12.2.2026_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has valid comparable evidence but mislabels the changed factor and uses insufficient/duplicated citations for acoustic measurements.
issues: Changed factor should be Test VP new mold V3.3 or VP TEST vs Normal V3 or VP NORMAL, not Normal V3 vs TIU C11-20R.
TIU C11-20R is model context, not the changed condition.
SPL, THD, and IMP outcomes are duplicated across header-derived groups.
Acoustic stats cite mainly header rows, not supporting data rows.
Tension subgroups Frame+VP and Coil+VP need separate baseline/test pairing.
correctionPlan: Rename changed factor to Test VP new mold V3.3 vs Normal V3 with TIU C11-20R as model context.
Map VP TEST to test mold and VP NORMAL to normal lot where supported.
Merge or remove duplicate SPL, THD, and IMP outcome groups.
Cite representative data rows or ranges for SPL, THD, and IMP statistics.
Split tension results by Frame+VP and Coil+VP while preserving their matched normal rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Functional and tension row citations are sufficient; acoustic citations need data rows beyond headers.
